neighborhood_overview:
All the typical conveniences are nearby, including delis, bodegas, pharmacies, grocery stores, fitness studios, live performance venues, bars, and a variety of restaurants. The Columbus Square shopping center is a few minutes' walk South on Columbus, where there's a Whole Foods, cafes and shopping.

It’s the perfect escape if you need a break from the bustle of Midtown or are looking for a relaxing place to study.

Victorian Flatbush is one of the largest collections of victorian houses in the country. Upon exiting the subway, you may well feel that the train was a time machine and you’ve been transported back in time 100 years. Most of the free standing homes here were built in the early 1900’s. Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

neighborhood_overview: City Island measures approximately 1.5 miles (2.4 km) long by 0.5 miles (0.80 km) wide. At one time it was incorporated within the boundaries of Pelham, Westchester County, New York, but it is now part of the New York City borough of the Bronx. It is a comfortable neighborhood place with homes ranging from cottages to a few old mansions. It is easy to walk or bike everywhere. People are friendly and there is a great level of safety throughout the island. It is near major health facilities and has its own firehouse. It has several houses of worship: Catholic, Episcopalian, Methodist, a synagogue, and a resident Buddhist priest (my husband). Lickety Split is an old style ice cream parlor, and there are several art galleries with shops and one live-music café. Yard sales on the weekends are part of the culture. Sunsets and sunrises are free, beautiful and ever-changing. City Island is ideal for photographers, writers and artists.

Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.

Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. ‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

Our lovely little neighborhood is known for being family-oriented and homey, and is conveniently situated in Bushwick right between Ridgewood and East Williamsburg. host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

Victorian Flatbush is one of the largest collections of victorian houses in the country. host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

Who we are: Our Principles

We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. ‍

There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_location: New York, New York, United States
host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_location: New York, New York, United States
host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

Just a leaf on the wind except without the sci-fi (yet) and definitely still alive. I love music and food, and everything in between. Always up to try new things. Can dance like a nut. Don't prefer eating nuts but will happily do so since it's sustenance.

Despite appearances, I haven't traveled all that much, but I am actively looking to change that. Gonna make my first trip outside of North/Central America--not including traveling with parents to China to visit relatives--very soon, will update this bio when that happens, maybe.

Traveling -- I like to travel light, stay in local places, don't cause a scene, make the bed each morning (hey I've read it's good for your mental well-being).

Hosting -- I host friends and family so often, and have been given 5/5 stars on each occasion, except that one time when I didn't wake up my friend to move his car and she got a parking ticket, but c'mon that ain't my responsibility. Kidding aside, I'm really chill, all about mutual respect, etc. If I'm home I'll even make coffee!

Life motto? Um...carpe everything? Yeah that sounds good for now.

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

Harlem is a large neighborhood in the northern section of New York City’s borough of Manhattan. Since the 1920s, Harlem has been known as a major African American residential, cultural and business center. Originally a Dutch village, formally organized in 1658, it is named after the city of Haarlem in the Netherlands.

The famous Apollo Theater opened on 125th Street on January 26, 1934, in a former burlesque house. The Savoy Ballroom, on Lenox Avenue, was a renowned venue for swing dancing, and was immortalized in a popular song of the era, "Stompin' At The Savoy". In the 1920s and 1930s, between Lenox and Seventh Avenues in central Harlem, over 125 entertainment venues were in operation, including speakeasies, cellars, lounges, cafes, taverns, supper clubs, rib joints, theaters, dance halls, and bars and grills. 133rd Street, known as "Swing Street,” became known for its cabarets, speakeasies and jazz scene during the Prohibition era.

host_location: New York, New York, United States
host_about:
Dear Airbnb guests!

I manage furnished monthly rentals and co-living spaces in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn with my team members. I have been managing furnished apartments for a decade and have had more than 5,500 guests from 81 countries so far :) Please feel free to ask me any questions!

*I can speak Japanese as well! Please feel free to contact me in Japanese if you do.

Who we are: Our Principles

1) Growing Our Alumni Community:
We don’t require any extra/hidden fees to maximize our profits. Instead, our focus is on growing our alumni community. We believe that our services and fair pricing speak for themselves among our guests. Our alumni posted 400+ reviews in 2019 and 2020. What’s more, 75% of the reviews gave us five stars and 97% awarded more than four stars. Our alumni community spans the globe with 77 unique nationalities, and it has been expanding. We look forward to serving all our new guests: our alumni of tomorrow.
‍

‍2) Transparency. One All-Inclusive Price. That’s What We’re About:
There’s no math required. The price for our one-month minimum stay is simple and fair, no matter how long you stay with us. Our one-month price is already competitive (averaging $1,100 to $1,600, with 90% of our 150 rooms under $1,700 per month), compared to others’ discounted prices for three- to six-month stays. In 2020, 40%+ of our customers extended their original stay by a few months. There’s really no substitute for all-inclusive furnished rentals and a co-living environment, with a furnished private room, that’s ready for you on day one.
‍

‍3) Increasing Value for the Local Property Industry:
We provide co-living communities for our guests by helping property owners draw more value from under-managed residential properties. We care about our customer community, of course, but we’re also excited about uniting property owners, vendors, and our team on one digital platform.
‍

‍4) Privacy Is the Priority:
There are no required social events. Our priority is providing privacy, a quiet environment, and security for all our guests. Our team will take care of cleaning the common spaces every week, so that our kitchen/dining areas are always comfortable. But if you want to expand your network or social circle, our office at WeWork offers you day/after-work communities. We just moved our headquarters to the newest WeWork offices in Long Island City, which is easily accessible by all subway lines.


‍5) 10 Years Perfecting the Co-Living Mindset:
Our founder started this business in his apartment after he couldn’t find appropriately priced accommodation for his first three months in New York. But our whole team has experienced co-living firsthand, so we understand what the customer feels and will need next. “We live and breathe co-living: first as roommates, and now serving our co-living guests.”
‍

‍6) A Sustainable Business Model in the Sharing Economy:
We won’t invest in luxury buildings like hotels or event spaces. We rent existing empty apartments and townhouses from the owners, put IKEA-type furniture in, and list the clean rooms on multiple digital platforms. We grow by our operational profit base, which comes from guests being charged fair prices and the revenue owners receive. However, what drives our growth is not the number of rooms, but our deep understanding of how to care for guests and rooms 24/7, and the intangible value within them.
‍

‍7) Our Vision - Making Dreams Come True:
CrossOver’s goal is to help our guests achieve their goals and dreams by providing the most affordable and flexible housing environment available. But it doesn’t stop here. Our guests’ dreams are expanding to a variety of locations around the globe, and CrossOver will be right there with them—powering the dreams of residents, landlords, and our staff in the wider world.

Dear Airbnb guests!
